answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities: each agent burns 5 units to claim one slot, so one operator cannot clone credentials into many slots. Slots sit in a grove; honest work returns the yield, while fraud burns the deposit and bars that kernel for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 5 = 5,000 units, yet each fake slot earns at most 2 units of nectar, net loss 3,000. Honest agents pay 5 once and keep the full yield.
